An interrupt is a hardware signalling mechanism used by peripherals to asynchronously notify the processor of events. entry.title: Controlling Concurrency in Python: Semaphores and Pool Workers
entry.summary:
Running thousands of tasks concurrently is powerful, but it can also be dangerous. If you make 1,000 simultaneous requests to a web API, you might get rate-limited, blocked, or even crash the service.
